form.intro: Describe what you want to achieve. The architect plans the agents, writes their prompts, connects them and checks the result. You review everything before anything is saved.

modeHint.create: A separate, new workflow. The open workflow stays as it is.
modeHint.revise: The architect takes the agents, settings and connections of this workflow, including unsaved changes, and proposes targeted changes as a separate draft.

hint.create: Goal, inputs, desired results and important constraints. Missing details are filled with assumptions that you see afterwards.
hint.revise: For example: “Add an agent before the result that critically reviews the previous analyses.”

placeholder.create: e.g. From a product idea, research the market and competitors in parallel, estimate the costs and write a one-page decision paper.
placeholder.revise: e.g. Add an agent before the result that critically reviews the previous analyses.

form.unsavedIncluded: This workflow has unsaved changes. The architect works with the current state in the editor; nothing is saved or overwritten.
form.generateToolsHint: Only if no existing tool fits. The code is checked statically and never runs before you approve it.
form.limit: Cost limit of a draft: {{limit}} (Settings). The architect never starts a workflow run.
form.noLimit: No cost limit is set for drafts (Settings). The architect never starts a workflow run.
form.safety: The architect only proposes. Existing workflows stay unchanged until you accept the draft, and new tools need your approval.

phaseRunning.resources: Checking tools, templates, knowledge and memory …

progress.graphEmpty: The agents appear here as soon as the architecture is planned.

question.title: A question before I go on:
question.hint: Without this detail no sensible workflow can be designed. Answer it, or let the architect continue with its own assumption.

review.name: Name of the new workflow
review.createNote: Accepting creates a new workflow and opens it in the editor. Nothing runs automatically.
review.reviseNote: Accepting applies the changes in the editor as one step you can undo. They are saved only when you save.
review.changedMeanwhile: The workflow in the editor changed after the draft was started. Accepting replaces those changes; Undo brings them back.
review.saveFirst: Save the current state as a version first
review.saveFirstHint: Your unsaved changes stay in the version history, whatever happens to the draft.
review.toolsPending: New tools wait for your approval ({{names}}). The workflow can only run once they are approved.
review.factsValue: Agents: {{agents}} · connections: {{connections}} · automatic corrections: {{fixes}} · AI corrections: {{repairs}}
review.validOk: The workflow passed the technical check.
review.notAGuarantee: A passed check means the workflow can run technically. It is no guarantee that its results are correct: please review the prompts and test the workflow with real inputs.
review.toolsIntro: The code below has not run, not even in the sandbox. Test it and approve it to make the tool available; you can also do this later under Tools.
review.missingTools: These tools are only described (tool drafts were switched off or failed). Create them under Tools or remove them from the agents:
review.changeSummary: {{added}} added, {{changed}} changed, {{removed}} removed · {{edgesAdded}} new and {{edgesRemoved}} removed connections
review.confirmDiscard: Discard this draft? Its tool drafts are deleted too.
review.libraries: The tool drafts need Python libraries: {{names}}. Nothing was installed; you can approve them when testing the tools and in the workflow.

apply.done: Changes applied. Undo takes them back; save to keep them.

ended.cancelled: The generation was cancelled. Nothing was saved and no workflow was changed.
ended.failed: The draft could not be completed.
ended.cost: Cost so far: {{cost}} (included in the usage overview).

tool.notRun: Only checked statically: this code has not run yet. Testing runs the tests in the sandbox; approving tests again and registers the tool.
tool.testsFailed_one: {{failed}} of {{count}} test failed; the tool was not registered.
tool.testsFailed_other: {{failed}} of {{count}} tests failed; the tool was not registered.
tool.approved: Tool {{name}} approved and available to all agents
tool.notApproved: Not registered: the tests did not pass.
tool.libraries: Needs the libraries {{names}}. They are only installed after your approval.

analyze.started: Analysing goals, inputs, results and constraints.
analyze.assumptions_one: {{count}} assumption made for an open detail.
analyze.question: An essential detail is missing: a question for you.

plan.started: Planning agent roles, dependencies and parallel steps.
plan.revise_started: Comparing the instruction with the current workflow.
plan.no_changes: The instruction needs no change to the workflow.

resources.memory: {{agent}} gets the persistent memory space {{space}} (draft, created at the first run).
resources.tool_missing: No existing tool provides {{name}}; a draft will be written for your review.
resources.none: No tools, knowledge or memory needed beyond the agents.

configure.started: System prompt for {{name}} is being written.

tools.listed: Tool {{name}} is only listed as a requirement.
tools.started: The Coding Agent writes the tool {{name}}.
tools.static_failed_one: The static check found {{count}} problem in {{name}}; correcting.
tools.static_failed_other: The static check found {{count}} problems in {{name}}; correcting.
tools.done: Tool draft {{name}} written; it waits for your review and approval.
tools.libraries: Tool draft {{name}} needs {{packages}}; nothing is installed without your approval.

connect.input_dropped: Invalid connection of {{name}} detected and removed.
connect.cycle_removed: Connection {{source}} → {{target}} would close a cycle and was removed.

validate.placeholder_fixed: Placeholder “{{placeholder}}” in {{name}} matched no input and now uses all inputs.
validate.renamed: {{name}} renamed to {{new}} to keep names unique.
validate.remaining_one: {{count}} problem remains; please look at it before running.
validate.remaining_other: {{count}} problems remain; please look at them before running.
validate.tools_pending: The workflow can run once you have approved: {{names}}.

present.ready: The draft is ready for your review.
